summary: Practise oilfield waste routing, produced-water controls and traceable records. Explore the five-day course outline and see how it fits your role.
lede: Oil and gas pollution control and waste management involves tracking pollution pathways and managing waste streams from source through treatment and transfer. For intermediate environmental, HSE and operations practitioners, the course covers mapping pathways, reconciling waste balances, reviewing produced-water results and choosing routes for drilling fluids, cuttings and oily residues. It also addresses inspection, monitoring and traceable records for waste handovers.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who make or verify daily decisions about oilfield discharges, waste handling and environmental records. It is designed for intermediate-level practitioners with experience in oil and gas operations, environmental work or HSE responsibilities.
modules: IFC EHS Guidelines and Site Barriers
prerequisites: Working familiarity with oil and gas operations, environmental management or HSE responsibilities is expected. No coding or specialist software knowledge is required.
